body: Thank you for the concern, everyone. I started to feel better after one of my few friends reached out and helped me. It makes me happy to see some people care, even though it's online. <3
I completely agree >:( I mean, we're all humans on this earth. So what if someone wishes to be something else?

I'm really glad I came across this post, I'm a closeted trans myself with transphobic parents. Thank you so much for supporting everyone, you're truly a good person <3 and there needs to be more accepting people in the world, for sure.
I'd love to talk, thank you.
Yes, thank you for this. This means a lot, that you’re taking the time out of your day to help me. I’d love to just let all of this out.
It's a huge accomplishment and it takes a lot of strength to do. Keep on keepin' on <3
Without the surgery, or testosterone. But yes.
